<h1>Sprite</h1>
<p class="sg-lede">The swallow, the seal, the seeds and three seed clusters as inline SVG symbols. Include system/graphics.js at the top of the body, then draw one with &lt;svg&gt;&lt;use href=&quot;#id&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;. The four pathway seeds stay with their pathways everywhere: site, thumbnails, slides.</p>
<dl class="sg-facts"><dt>Use for</dt><dd>Site furniture: the hero flock, the closing seal, pathway seeds, dividers.</dd><dt>Colour</dt><dd>Ink of the ground (currentColor): ink on light grounds, chalk on night.</dd><dt>Grounds</dt><dd>White, Paper, Sunlight, Night</dd><dt>Registers</dt><dd>Study, Conversation, Gathering</dd><dt>Formats</dt><dd>Inline SVG symbols</dd><dt>Rights</dt><dd>Ours to use anywhere.</dd></dl>
